title: The Best Easy Low Carb Meatloaf (with Beef)

ingredients.raw: 1.5 lb Ground Beef 90% lean- do not use leaner than 90% or higher fat than 85%
ingredients.prep: 90% lean- do not use leaner than 90% or higher fat than 85%

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup Unsweetened Ketchup (Primal Kitchen Brand recommended)
2 tbsp. Coconut Sugar (Brown sugar also fine)

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Saute onion, carrot and garlic with 1 tbsp. olive oil for 5-7 minutes until onion is translucent and carrots are softened.
Add sauteed vegetables to a large bowl with oats, milk, Worcestershire, Dijon, tomato paste, salt, pepper and egg. Whisk together.
Add ground beef and lightly mix using hands or fork until well incorporated.
Place mixture onto oiled sheet tray and form into a loaf approximately 13-14 inches long and 6 inches wide.
Bake for 30 minutes. Mix sauce ingredients during this time.
After 30 minutes, add sauce to top and cook another 10-15 minutes until thermometer reaches 160 degrees.
Allow to rest 20-30 minutes before slicing and serving.
concerns: Instructions call for 1 tbsp. olive oil (saute step) but olive oil does not appear as an ingredient line on the page.
Recipe is titled 'low carb' but the ingredient list includes 1/2 cup Quick Oats and 2 tbsp. Coconut Sugar; the page's stated nutrition is 19g carbohydrates per serving. Transcribed as printed.
